verified_facts.text: Hotel Nantipa is a beachfront boutique hotel in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, on the Nicoya Peninsula.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Nantipa is a luxury beachfront boutique hotel in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, where refined comfort meets the relaxed rhythm of the Nicoya Peninsula.

verified_facts.text: The Nicoya Peninsula, where Nantipa is located, is one of the world's five Blue Zones.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the Nicoya Peninsula, one of the world's five Blue Zones, Nantipa offers a wellness experience

verified_facts.text: The Ninta Beachfront Bungalows each have a terrace, a private plunge pool, a hammock and a double indoor/outdoor shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ninta bungalows are made up of 80 square meters (800 square feet) of luxury space including an ample terrace, a private 3.5 x 3.5 meter (10 x 10 ft) plunge pool, hammock, king bed and double indoor/outdoor shower.

verified_facts.text: In the Ninta bungalows, floor-to-ceiling glass doors open to ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our floor to ceiling glass doors open to ocean views, making Ninta ideal for a memorable honeymoon

verified_facts.text: Ninta, the name of the beachfront bungalows, is the Chorotegan word for beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: "Ninta" is the Chorotegan word for "beach"

verified_facts.text: In the Manti bungalows, floor-to-ceiling glass doors open to garden views, surrounded by forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our floor to ceiling glass doors open to garden views, making Manti ideal for a memorable honeymoon or just a romantic getaway surrounded by raw nature and the mystic sound of the forest.

verified_facts.text: The Beachfront Villas are private three-bedroom villas with direct beach access, a fully equipped kitchen and a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private three-bedroom luxury villas with direct beach access, fully equipped kitchen, large social area and private pool.

verified_facts.text: The Nanku Suites are designed for small families or groups.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Nanku Suites are perfect for small families or groups. They offer a sleeping area with either one king bed or two queen beds

verified_facts.text: Numu Wellness Center is an open-air wellness space set within the Nantipa Gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within the Nantipa Gardens, Numu Wellness Center is an open-air wellness sanctuary in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, designed to restore balance, calm the mind, and renew the body.

verified_facts.text: Numu offers daily yoga, meditation, breathwork, Pilates and sound healing sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Daily yoga, meditation, breathwork, Pilates, and sound healing sessions offer space to move with intention, restore energy, and reconnect with the body.

verified_facts.text: Nantipa has a dedicated Yoga Shala.
verified_facts.excerpt: all centered around our dedicated Yoga Shala

verified_facts.text: Manzu is the hotel's beachfront restaurant, serving Costa Rican cuisine with a refined twist alongside sunset cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Start the evening at our beachfront restaurant Manzú, where sunset cocktails meet Costa Rican cuisine with a refined twist.

verified_facts.text: Tabacon Thermal Resort & Spa in the Arenal Volcano region is Nantipa's sister property, and retreats can extend there.
verified_facts.excerpt: retreat experiences can also extend to Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa, Nantipa's sister property in the Arenal Volcano region

verified_facts.text: The beach, surf breaks, local restaurants and the Santa Teresa strip are within walking distance of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many of the best experiences are within walking distance: the beach, surf breaks, local restaurants, and the vibrant Santa Teresa strip are just steps away.

verified_facts.text: The closest airstrip is Cobano Airport, reached by daily scheduled flights from San Jose operated by SANSA and Green Airways.
verified_facts.excerpt: both SANSA and Green Airways operate daily scheduled flights to Cóbano Airport (ACO), the closest airstrip to Santa Teresa

verified_facts.text: Guests can drive or take a private transfer from San Jose via Route 27 and the Puntarenas-Paquera ferry.
verified_facts.excerpt: Drive or arrange a private transfer from San José via Route 27 and the Puntarenas-Paquera ferry.

verified_facts.text: The concierge team can arrange private drivers for day trips to Montezuma and Cabo Blanco Nature Reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our concierge team can arrange private drivers for day trips to Montezuma, Cabo Blanco Nature Reserve, or the Nicoya Peninsula's hidden gems.

verified_facts.text: Bicycles are available at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bicycles are available at the hotel, perfect for short trips along the coast and nearby shops.

verified_facts.text: Nantipa supports reforestation initiatives, beach preservation and community engagement.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nantipa supports reforestation initiatives, beach preservation, community engagement, and responsible tourism practices

verified_facts.text: Nantipa and Numu create custom-designed wellness retreats for small groups.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nantipa and Numu create custom-designed wellness retreats in Costa Rica for small groups seeking restoration, connection, and a more intentional pace of travel.

verified_facts.text: Numu's treatments use natural, eco-conscious products and locally inspired ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each experience is delivered by skilled therapists using natural, eco-conscious products and locally inspired ingredients

contradictions.note: p4 says Nantipa is 15-20 minutes from Cobano Airport but also says ~45 minute drive from the airstrip

sources.excerpt: From the airport, Nantipa is just 15–20 minutes by taxi or private transfer.
~45 minute drive along the coast to Santa Teresa
